name: Auth0 OAuth MCP Server
description: A Model Context Protocol server that requires user authentication via Auth0 before enabling secure API access on behalf of the authenticated user.

rawRecord.description: A Model Context Protocol server that requires user authentication via Auth0 before enabling secure API access on behalf of the authenticated user.

NODE_ENV.description: The environment setting - use development for local development

AUTH0_SCOPE.description: The scopes requested by the MCP Server. Here we request basic profile info (openid email profile), refresh token capability (offline_access), and API access (read:todos)

API_BASE_URL.description: The base URL where your Todos API is running

AUTH0_DOMAIN.description: The domain of your Auth0 tenant (e.g., acme.auth0.com)

AUTH0_AUDIENCE.description: The unique identifier for your API which you registered in the Auth0 dashbaord (e.g., urn:todos-api)

AUTH0_CLIENT_ID.description: The Client ID from the Auth0 application you created

AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Client Secret from the Auth0 application you created
